agent_inactive: Agent has status '{status}' — call rejected before processing
no_eligible_provider: No model provider is able to serve the agent's model '{model}' at the required data sensitivity level '{sensitivity}'. Either no active provider supports this sensitivity level, or none of the eligible providers lists this model (the gateway deliberately does not silently substitute a different model). Contact your administrator — activate a provider that supports this model and sensitivity level, or lower the data sensitivity of the request.
unknown_agent: Unknown agent_id: {agent_id} — not in the GovAI registry
